03 / Mark of the Survivors

11° FORWARD

Scroll to explore ↓

  1. 11The 11 honors Manning’s surgery date, the 11th. “Forward” represents life beyond that day: resilience, possibility, and the freedom to keep moving.
  2. 11°The icon and wordmark share an 11° forward lean, expressing movement and momentum. It’s a reminder to keep looking ahead.
  3. Better things aheadThe mark points up and to the right, a reminder that better things lie ahead. Wherever we are in the journey, we keep moving forward together.
  4. Always Next Step ForwardTwo ascending forms represent steps forward, with progress built one step at a time. Flat edges bring clarity and control.
